_comment: An example TELEMACHUS_ONBOARDING_FILE: a Japanese-market beta funnel that
collects 法人番号 (the 13-digit Corporate Number) INSTEAD of annual revenue.
1. `revenue` is simply absent from `fields`, and that is all it takes to turn
it off — nothing else in the product demands it. `email` is the ONE field
that cannot be removed: the anti-abuse model is keyed on it (per-email and
per-domain velocity caps, the disposable-address check, prospect dedup).
2. `corporate_number` is not a reserved column, so it needs no migration — it
lands in the prospect's `attributes` blob and shows up in Admin > Beta
like any other field. Nothing was added to the schema for it.
Validation vocabulary is deliberately small and safe: required, digits,
minlength, maxlength. There is no regex, on purpose — an admin-authored
pattern would run against attacker-chosen input on a public endpoint.
